title: Monetary Policy Committee dates for 2027
content: Monetary Policy Committee dates for 2027 2027 confirmed dates Published on 17 September 2026 News release MPC Announcement and Minutes publication Monetary Policy Report publication 4 February 2027 4 February 2027 18 March 2027 29 April 2027 29 April 2027 17 June 2027 29 July 2027 29 July 2027 16 September 2027 4 November 2027 4 November 2027 16 December 2027 Notes to editors In line with the commitment made following the 2014 Warsh Review, the Bank of England publishes annually, after a delay of eight years, key MPC documentation. This includes written transcripts of policy meetings and key staff inputs that informed the policy decision. The next release will be on 7 January 2027, pertaining to all MPC meetings between January and December 2018. This timeline follows the Bank’s standard release policy, which is based on that used by The UK National Archives. Further information about the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is available on the monetary policy page .
